messages.subject: Project Umbra - draft Disclosure Letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia,

Draft Disclosure Letter attached for the warranties. Main specific disclosures: the Mehl co-inventor assignment on GB2611902, the historic Verdigris query, two open priority-3 defects in the satellite module (ATL-1187, ATL-1203), and the OSS bill of materials. Please confirm fairly and accurately disclosed.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
